connector.name: Microsoft SQL Server
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP for Microsoft SQL Server: metadata discovery, parameterized SELECT, plans.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package Alyio.McpMssql. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alyiox account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: MCPMSSQL_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: Default profile SQL Server connection string (often contains secrets). Optional if profiles are only in user appsettings.

env.name: MCPMSSQL_DESCRIPTION
env.description: Optional human-readable description for the default profile.

env.name: MCPMSSQL_QUERY_MAX_ROWS
env.description: Max rows per interactive query (default 500; ceiling 1000).

env.name: MCPMSSQL_QUERY_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env.description: Interactive query command timeout in seconds (default 30).

env.name: MCPMSSQL_QUERY_SNAPSHOT_MAX_ROWS
env.description: Max rows for snapshot queries (default 10000; ceiling 50000).

env.name: MCPMSSQL_ANALYZE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env.description: Execution plan analysis timeout in seconds (default 300).

env.name: MCPMSSQL_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Enable write commands (DDL/DML) via run_command on the default profile (default false). Soft guard only — prefer a db_datareader login for a hard read-only guarantee.

env.name: MCPMSSQL_WRITE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env.description: Write command timeout in seconds (default 60; ceiling 600).

env.name: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Set to Development to load dotnet user-secrets (local dev).
